source: vendored listing of the tools the built-in block names, over streamable-http
note: The tools/list answer of VirusTotal's own MCP server for the tools its built-in block names (core.virustotal.LOOKUP_TOOLS and SUBMIT_TOOLS), each with its inputSchema and annotations as that server lists them; descriptions shortened to one line. The lookups' annotations are the ones recorded with the lookups of the stored benchmark runs (haiku5 to haiku7); the submit tools are written as write tools that reach outside, as their descriptions say. submit_local_file is the stdio form's own tool. The platform reads what each tool is from this listing (core.derived_declarations); nothing here is shipped.

tools.name: get_analysis
tools.description: Read one analysis registered to the current VTAI account.

tools.name: get_domain_report
tools.description: Look up existing intelligence for a DNS domain name, without resolving or visiting it.

tools.name: get_file_report
tools.description: Look up an existing file report by hexadecimal MD5, SHA-1 or SHA-256 hash.

tools.name: get_ip_report
tools.description: Look up existing intelligence for an IPv4 or IPv6 address.

tools.name: get_submission
tools.description: Recover the current account's receipt with exactly one sha256 or request_id.

tools.name: get_url_report
tools.description: Look up existing intelligence for one HTTP(S) URL.

tools.name: submit_file
tools.description: Submit canonical base64 bytes matching SHA256, at most 24000000 decoded bytes.

tools.name: submit_local_file
tools.description: Submit one local regular file of at most 32000000 bytes in standard mode.
